args.missing_evidence: Post-run sample characterization to determine if the target material grew.

evidence.observation: Temperature tracks setpoints appropriately through all stages.
Argon flow matches setpoints (200 sccm in purge, 100 sccm afterwards).
Pressure behaves nominally based on Ar flow (4 Torr at 200 sccm, 3 Torr at 100 sccm).
Oxygen levels fall and remain below 10 ppm after purging.
